The learning route

100 levels in every part. Your next step unlocks as you go.

NO RUSH FOR THE FIRST FOUR PARTS. PART 5 ONWARD: 200 SECONDS PER PART.

How to play

  1. Choose Play now and solve each question. Type your answer and press Enter or Check.
  2. Correct answers earn coins, build your streak, and unlock the next level. There are 100 levels in each part.
  3. A wrong answer costs 10% of your coins, so take your time and try again.
  4. The first four parts are untimed. From BEDMAS onward, you have 200 seconds to finish each part.
